name: Sawtooth Snapper Claw
summary: Sawtooth Snapper Claws come from the sawtooth snappers along the Swamp of Sorrows coast. Tok'Kar prepares them as weapons to help defend Stonard.

sections.title: Claws for Stonard
sections.body: Along the coast of the Swamp of Sorrows, Tok'Kar asks for Sawtooth Snapper Claws to strengthen Stonard's defenses. The snappers' claws make fine weapons when properly prepared. Tok'Kar is stationed on the coast to watch for murlocs and warn Stonard if danger grows too great.

faq.q: Where do Sawtooth Snapper Claws come from?
faq.answer: Sawtooth Snapper Claws come from sawtooth snappers along the Swamp of Sorrows coast.
Tok'Kar wants Sawtooth Snapper Claws to prepare weapons for Stonard's defense.

faq.q: Why does Tok'Kar need the claws?
faq.answer: Tok'Kar says the claws make fine weapons when properly prepared, giving Stonard more weapons ready for an attack.

faq.q: What is Tok'Kar doing on the coast?
faq.answer: Tok'Kar and his force watch the coast to protect Stonard or warn it if a threat grows too large.

angles.text: Tok'Kar is helping guard Stonard, an orc settlement, from threats along the coast.
